newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Shares in KLM surge on buy-back talks.
newsitem.headline: Shares in KLM surge on buy-back talks.

text.p: KLM shares were among the strongest gainers on a surging Amsterdam bourse after the airline announced Monday it was in exploratory talks with the Dutch government on the partial buy-back of the state's 38.2 percent KLM stake.
Dealers said the negotiations were seen by the market as a step in the right direction to making KLM a more attractive alliance partner.
"The gain is purely speculative, we don't know whether any transaction will go ahead, but investors seem to like the idea," one said.
He said demand for KLM shares had initially been driven by positions-covering on the options exchange, but that end-investors were also stepping into the stock.
KLM shares were up two guilders or 4.81 percent at 43.60 guilders around 1030 GMT, off an earlier high of 44.70 guilders.
The AEX index of leading shares opened Monday at a new all-time high of 622.86 points.
